name: Live Subtitle Style
description: Adds a subtitle style button to the Jellyfin web player OSD. Size, font, color, background, outline and position change live, with no playback restart. Requires the File Transformation plugin.
overview: Live subtitle styling in the web player

versions.changelog: The Font row now says whether the chosen font can be used in the browser you are watching in: green 'Installed on this device', red 'Not available in this browser, default font used', or 'Web font from Google Fonts'. Browsers with font-fingerprint protection (for example Brave Shields, Firefox with resistFingerprinting) hide installed fonts, in which case use a web font.

Redesigned subtitle style popup: header, icon tiles, red sliders with value boxes, toggle switch, font dropdown, colour swatches and a Reset button. The OSD button is now an 'Aa' glyph. The font box can list the fonts actually installed on the device (Chrome asks permission once), and Thai serif web fonts close to Angsana and Dillenia were added (Noto Serif Thai, Trirong, Taviraj, Pridi).

Added Google Fonts with Thai support (Sarabun, Mitr, Prompt, Kanit, Noto Sans Thai), listed as web fonts in the font field. A font is fetched from Google Fonts only when you select it, so it works on devices without the Windows Thai fonts.

The font control is a type-in field with suggestions, so any font installed on the viewing device works. Thai fonts (Angsana New, AngsanaUPC, DilleniaUPC, Cordia New, Browallia New, TH Sarabun New, Leelawadee UI) come first.
Full version history in the plugin metadata.
Font selector (live); new 'Aa' icon instead of the subtitle-picker look-alike.

Fixed the OSD and keyboard controls disappearing. File Transformation matched index.html as a regex, which also matched the video player's JavaScript chunk, and the script tag was appended to it. Only markup is modified now.
